kpis.description_fr: Ventes Nexplanon (contraceptif sous-cutané), produit phare Organon, 14% du CA Groupe. Patent expiry rod 2027 US, applicator 2030.
kpis.description_en: Nexplanon (subdermal contraceptive implant) sales - Organon's flagship product, ~14% of group. US rod patent expiry 2027, applicator 2030.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu portefeuille Women's Health (Nexplanon + Follistim + NuvaRing + Jada + Marvelon) - 28% du CA Groupe, 49% hors USA.
kpis.description_en: Women's Health portfolio revenue (Nexplanon + Follistim + NuvaRing + Jada + Marvelon) - 28% of group, 49% ex-US.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu portfolio Established Brands (cardiovasculaire ezetimibe Atozet/Zetia, respi, derm Vtama, pain Emgality) - 59% du CA, 91% hors USA. Forte exposition genericisation.
kpis.description_en: Established Brands portfolio (cardiovascular ezetimibe family, respiratory, derm Vtama, pain Emgality) - 59% of revenue, 91% ex-US. High generic exposure.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Follistim AQ (fertilité), demande US en hausse 2025, partiellement compensé recul Chine.
kpis.description_en: Follistim AQ (fertility) sales - rising US demand 2025, partly offset by China weakness.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Jada System (hémorragie postpartum) - croissance +22%. Cession finalisée janvier 2026 à Laborie.
kpis.description_en: Jada System (postpartum hemorrhage) sales - +22% growth. Divested January 2026 to Laborie.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition Dermavant (Vtama, tapinarof eczéma/psoriasis) en 2024 pour $1.2 Mds. Pic ventes potentiel $1+ Mds avec extension eczéma 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Dermavant acquisition (Vtama, tapinarof eczema/psoriasis) in 2024 for $1.2B. Peak sales potential $1B+ with 2025 eczema extension.

_notes: Excellent disclosure: drug-by-drug + portfolio-level. 3-year history per drug. Nexplanon LOE timeline critical for forecasts (2027 US, 2026 ex-US).
